actions.create_entity.description: Creates an entity (record) in your Base44 app
actions.create_entity.props.entityData.d: The data to create the entity with
actions.create_entity.props.entityType.d: The name of the entity type (e.g. "Product", "User", "Order")
actions.delete_entity_record.description: Permanently deletes an entity record by its ID
actions.delete_entity_record.props.entit: The name of the entity type (e.g. "Product", "User", "Order")
actions.delete_entity_record.props.recor: The ID of the record to delete
actions.find_entity.description: Find a matching entity record in your Base44 app
actions.find_entity.props.entityType.des: The name of the entity type (e.g. "Product", "User", "Order")
actions.find_entity.props.limit.descript: Maximum number of records to return (1-500). Defaults to 50.
actions.find_entity.props.sort.descripti: Field to sort by. Prefix with "-" for descending (e.g. "-created_date").
actions.find_or_create_entity.descriptio: Find a matching entity record, or create one if not found
actions.find_or_create_entity.props.crea: Data to create the entity with if not found
actions.find_or_create_entity.props.enti: The name of the entity type (e.g. "Product", "User", "Order")
actions.get_entity_record.description: Retrieves a single entity record by its ID
actions.get_entity_record.props.entityTy: The name of the entity type (e.g. "Product", "User", "Order")
actions.get_entity_record.props.recordId: The ID of the record to retrieve
actions.list_entity_records.description: Lists records of an entity type with sorting and paging
actions.list_entity_records.props.entity: The name of the entity type (e.g. "Product", "User", "Order")
Maximum number of records to return (1-500). Defaults to 50.
actions.list_entity_records.props.skip.d: Number of records to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0.
actions.list_entity_records.props.sort.d: Field to sort by. Prefix with "-" for descending (e.g. "-created_date").
actions.update_entity_record.description: Updates fields of an existing entity record
actions.update_entity_record.props.entit: The name of the entity type (e.g. "Product", "User", "Order")
actions.update_entity_record.props.recor: The ID of the record to update
actions.update_entity_record.props.updat: Fields to change (e.g. {"status": "shipped"}). Fields not included are left unchanged.
auth.description:
Authenticate with your Base44 app using your App ID and API token.

**App ID**: Your Base44 application ID (required)
**Token**: Your Base44 service token (optional). When set, requests run with the service role (admin access to all app data); without it only publicly readable data is available.

You can find these in your Base44 app settings or dashboard.
auth.props.token.description: Your Base44 service token. Leave empty to access only public app data.
description: Build and manage custom apps with databases and entities
triggers.entity_event.description: Triggers when an entity is created or updated
triggers.entity_event.props.entityType.d: The name of the entity type (e.g. "Product", "User", "Order")
triggers.entity_event.props.eventType.de: When to trigger. "Updated" ignores newly created records that were never edited.
